lines.speaker: Commander, Orpiment
lines.text: Panther Commander is reporting rogue behaviors from AI 'Steel'. Open a call - get engineers, Panther soldiers, and Steel itself on this line. I want to hear from anyone or any *thing* that can explain what's going on.

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Calling now... I'm getting an error contacting Steel - all net traffic is being dropped. Looks like a tower got damaged in the Panther Simulation. Backup lines are also failing. I can't get a response from Steel, sir!

lines.speaker: Commander, Orpiment
lines.text: Nonsense. Open a direct space-to-core connection to Steel. Net towers are old tech, maybe this AI 'prefers' the shiny, new-age stuff. These new personality models tend to get a bit obsessive at times.

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Space-to-core connection started... No response, sir! Steel claims it's expending resources on simulation efforts, unable to divert energy for a comms agent. Engineers are already looking into it.

lines.speaker: Commander, Orpiment
lines.text: Towers and satellite comms can't punch through? That can't be an accident. Engineers: I'm flagging Steel as 'off-course', shut down all of Steel's power and data centers ASAP. Begin remediation after Steel is offline.

lines.speaker: Commander, Orpiment
lines.text: Soldier: Launch all ground units within a 20-kilometer radius of Steel's manufacturing site. The city is less than a day's travel from that location, raise the alarm for local officials and activate defense mechanisms. Better safe than-

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Red alert, commander! Defense mechanisms just entered maintenance mode! Engineers' attempts at Steel shutdown have failed - they're escalating now. City officials are requesting an open military call. Would you like me to connect them?

lines.speaker: Commander, Orpiment
lines.text: What in the... just now? How did it... Yes, connect the officials. Mark this call as SitRoom 1 for the Panther/Steel event. We need to move fast...
